description: Annual showcase of Mornington Peninsula's cool-climate wines over the King's Birthday long weekend. Centrepiece event: Winter Wine Festival at Red Hill Showgrounds — taste 35 wineries and 150 wines, with a RIEDEL tasting glass included, plus masterclasses, food, and live music. Broader weekend includes cellar door open days, long lunches, and masterclasses across the region.
priceRange: General Admission $90; Masterclass upgrade $105; Designated Driver $30
suitableFor: Wine enthusiasts; adults (18+); foodies; weekend visitors
accessibilityNotes: Mainly flat showgrounds; RIEDEL glass provided; pram ok for child accompanying adults
weatherDependency: Low — event proceeds in all weather (marquee/pavilion structure)
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill village; Arthurs Seat Eagle; Red Hill wineries; Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie
suggestedItineraryPairing: Stay King's Birthday weekend; pair Saturday festival with Sunday cellar door trail
internalNotes: 2026 dates confirmed 6–8 June on The Ninch official listing (published 16 Apr 2026). Humanitix listing currently shows 2025 details; 2026 ticket link not yet live at time of check. Price range based on 2025 pricing — may change. Masterclass host: Ed Merrison.
